newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan to boost aluminium product output by 2000.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to boost aluminium product output by 2000.

text.p: Taiwan's top aluminium products maker China Steel Aluminium Co pledged on Wednesday to invest NT$2.6 billion to boost production by 70 to 80 percent a year by 2000.
A plant expansion would be completed in 1999, raising capacity to 118,000 tonnes of aluminium products a year from 65,000 to 70,000 tonnes now, a company executive said.
China Steel Aluminium, a subsidiary of China Steel Corp, planned to go public in five years, he said.
The executive declined to give a breakdown of the aluminium maker's production, saying output fluctuated to reflect demand.
Taiwan imported about 480,000 tonnes of gross aluminium in 1995, up from 450,000 tonnes in 1994.
